title: FBI Photo A006
sensor_system_note: A-series — different sensor system from B-series. Small '+' reticle with horizontal tick row, NO timestamp visible, '5' scale mark only. A001-A006 are aerial terrain views (sensor pointed down at ground). A007 is the polarity-anomaly frame (sky background, bright specular target). A008 is sky background with normal dark-on-light polarity. Treat as adjacent-not-paired with B-series.

pages.image_type: black-and-white thermal/infrared imagery with targeting reticle
pages.description: A grayscale thermal or infrared video frame showing a flat, open landscape viewed through a targeting optic. A white crosshair reticle is centered in the frame, consisting of horizontal and vertical lines with incremental tick marks (graticule) for ranging. Near the center, slightly below and left of the crosshair intersection, is a small dark round spot. Several solid black rectangular blocks are overlaid across the image, likely redactions, located in the upper-left corner, mid-left, lower-left, lower-center, and right side. The terrain appears as a muted gray plain with faint darker markings suggesting ground features. A small numeral is visible to the right of the crosshair.
